'''''Imbak''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] which was on the search for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] as they were escaping to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

==Behind the scenes==
On Mission 20A of Tour of Duty 5, it arrives 20 minutes after the start of the mission
